scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n portal,resources,geographic,marine -c cyan,blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @ocean-cloud/portal" "npm run dev -w @ocean-cloud/resources" "npm run dev -w @ocean-cloud/geographic-information" "npm run dev -w @ocean-cloud/marine-information"
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n portal,resources,geographic,marine "npm run preview -w @ocean-cloud/portal" "npm run preview -w @ocean-cloud/resources" "npm run preview -w @ocean-cloud/geographic-information" "npm run preview -w @ocean-cloud/marine-information"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run build
